## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Super DA Errors on Hold
The issue [#725](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/725), concerning the addition of missing Super DA Errors, received an update. The latest comment from emhane indicates that this issue is currently "on ice" and will be revisited when a new interoperability design is rolled out. This suggests a dependency on broader architectural changes within the Optimism ecosystem.
